# India needs its own institutions that just don't participate in AI — they shape it.

We believe AI in India will be built by technical crack teams. Activate is a new age venture firm purpose-built for such founders, engaging with them well before incorporation and investing $500k–$3M at inception.

[Aakrit](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aakrit/) ran Haptik, one of India's first AI companies (acquired by Reliance Jio). Angel investor in 100+ startups and recently Advisor to IndiaAI Mission. [Pratyush](https://www.linkedin.com/in/177pc/) was part of the team that backed Composio, Emergent, Rocket.new from India. Runs APAC's largest GenAI community.

The Activate platform combines _Capability, Community & Content_ — honed through 2 decades of shared experiences & deep networks.

[Apply to Activate Fellows — India's first student builder summer program →](https://www.activatevc.ai/fellows)

## Inception Investing

We partner with founders before incorporation, helping validate ideas and co-building during the earliest product stages. Our engagement goes beyond capital—we bring hands-on support to help teams move from zero to one.

We lead the first institutional funding round, investing $500k–$3M to accelerate development. From technical architecture to go-to-market, we help founders build with velocity, depth, and taste.

## Projects

We run India's largest Generative AI community spanning 15k+ technical practitioners. [Request here to join](https://nas.io/the-generativeai-group).

[Activate Signal](https://www.activatevc.ai/signal) is our media platform focused on crafting India's AI narrative. Signal aims to be not another VC brand propaganda, but rather the defining voice of what's happening in AI in India.

## What we believe in

_Velocity_ : Imagine the fastest you have worked & shipped things before, and multiply it by 10x. Companies are getting created in days now, not even weeks.

_Depth_ : Everyone knows everything now, the only way to achieve excellence is being an expert on your domain. It can be an industry vertical or a research topic or a particular piece of tech. You need to know more about it than 99.99% of everyone else in the world.

_Taste_ : Intuition has never commanded more premium than before. There is no way to develop this other than surround yourself with incredible people who have it. The finer details and small decisions make or break.

_Influence_ : Attention is all you need, truly. The game is being played at just a whole new level now. Think Cluely, Sydney Sweeney x AE, Astronomer x Gwyneth. This muscle needs to be in the DNA of every org.

## Value Stack

## Key Drivers for India

### AI Applications

Consumer, Prosumer, Enterprise

### Key Drivers

• Transformation of the $250B BPO industry with AI-led services

• AI experts tailored to local needs (Doctor, Teacher, Farmer)

• AI-native solutions for large local industry - Fintech, E-Commerce, Healthcare

### Infrastructure Tooling

LLMOps, Data Ops, Evals

### Key Drivers

• Best in class developer talent driven by 500M+ user base consumer apps

• Data labeling, quality & annotation platforms powered by abundant skilled labor

• Enterprise-grade observability, born from decades of IT Services expertise

### Foundation Models

LLMs, SLMs, Multimodal

### Key Drivers

• Sovereign LLMs adapted for local languages and government needs

• Building speech-first models for the world's largest voice search market

• Specific industry niche models in defence, biotech, logistics, etc.

### Accelerated Compute

AI Cloud, AI Hardware

### Key Drivers

• Semiconductor design talent for custom silicon in AI workloads

• Training vs. inference specialization optimized to local pricing

• Energy efficiency & supply chain resilience for geopolitical gains

### Physical Infrastructure

Data Centers, Power, Cooling

### Key Drivers

• Sovereign data center capacity & localization (regulatory)

• Advanced cooling & energy efficiency innovations tailored for India

• Fiber network build outs for low-latency connectivity
